invariants.statement: Generated outputs are non-canonical; MASTER YAML and governed registries remain authoritative.
Semantic colours transform by theme rather than simple inversion.
Every major semantic change must preserve tuple lineage.
Reconstruction is idempotent for identical source ledgers.
Competing branches remain explicit until evidence supports convergence.
Publication promotion requires a content-addressed renderer execution receipt whose hashes and checks are independently revalidated.
Multi-format publication promotion is atomic: every required renderer receipt, renderer-native check and cross-format parity check must pass before one bundle promotion receipt may PROMOTE.

GitHub Pages counts as published only after a real Pages deployment returns a hosted URL and an independent network fetch of that hosted URL reproduces the governed Pages artifact hash and semantic token set for the exact source commit.

Visual snapshot promotion requires a real browser-rendered PNG bound to the same source commit and A9 carrier receipt, with independently revalidated hashes and passing dimensions, clipping, overflow, text-visibility, contrast, element-coverage, semantic-parity and replay checks.

A GitHub Pages deployment-success signal is not sufficient hosted evidence: promotion requires at least two consecutive exact governed hosted responses while holding the repository-wide Pages deployment concurrency boundary, followed by an independent repeat of that convergence check.

Every repository workflow that executes actions/deploy-pages@v4 against the shared CODEX Pages endpoint must participate in concurrency group pages; a deployer outside that boundary is a publication-ownership defect and blocks A9 hosted promotion.
